description.raw: '''Passive:''' ''[[File:Fiora Duelist's Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Duelist's Dance|An icon for Fiora's ability Duelist's Dance]] [[Fiora#Duelist's Dance|Duelist's Dance's]]'' [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed is increased.
description.text: Passive: Duelist's Dance's  bonus movement speed is increased.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fiora''' challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their Vitals after a 0.5-second delay. While in effect, ''[[File:Fiora Duelist's Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Duelist's Dance|An icon for Fiora's ability Duelist's Dance]] [[Fiora#Duelist's Dance|Duelist's Dance]]'' does not identify new Vitals on ''Grand Challenge's'' target, and unlike ''[[File:Fiora Duelist's Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Duelist's Dance|An icon for Fiora's ability Duelist's Dance]] [[Fiora#Duelist's Dance|Duelist's Dance]]'', ''Grand Challenge's'' Vitals will linger regardless of range.
description2.text: Active: Fiora challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their Vitals after a 0.5-second delay. While in effect, Duelist's Dance does not identify new Vitals on Grand Challenge's target, and unlike Duelist's Dance, Grand Challenge's Vitals will linger regardless of range.

description3.raw: While near the target, '''Fiora''' gains ''[[File:Fiora Duelist's Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Duelist's Dance|An icon for Fiora's ability Duelist's Dance]] [[Fiora#Duelist's Dance|Duelist's Dance's]]'' [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed.
description3.text: While near the target, Fiora gains Duelist's Dance's  bonus movement speed.

description4.raw: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one Vital before the target [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or triggers all four otherwise, a ''[[File:Fiora Grand Challenge 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|An icon for Fiora's ability Grand Challenge 2]] [[Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|Victory Zone]]'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every 0.25 seconds.
description4.text: If Fiora triggers at least one Vital before the target dies, or triggers all four otherwise, a Victory Zone is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which heals Fiora and all allies within the area every 0.25 seconds.

leveling.raw:
'''Additional Bonus Movement Speed:'''
10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30%

leveling4.raw:
'''Heal per Tick:'''
18.75 / 21.875 / 25 / 28.125 / 31.25 (+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)
'''Heal per Second:'''
75 / 87.5 / 100 / 112.5 / 125 (+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)
'''Maximum Heal:'''
375 / 437.5 / 500 / 562.5 / 625 (+ 300% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * ''Grand Challenge'' is dispelled instantly if targeting a [[decoy]]. ** ''Grand Challenge'' cannot be cast on [[File:Sion OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Sion|An icon representing Sion]] [[Sion|Sion's]] [[File:Sion Glory in Death.png|20xpx|border|link=Sion#Glory in Death|An icon for Sion's ability Glory in Death]] [[Sion#Glory in Death|Glory in Death]]. * The damage of this ability scales with [[File:Fiora Duelist's Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Duelist's Dance|An icon for Fiora's ability Duelist's Dance]] [[Fiora#Duelist's Dance|Duelist's Dance]]. * Even if '''Fiora''' dies, the [[File:Fiora Grand Challenge 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|An icon for Fiora's ability Grand Challenge 2]] [[Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|''Victory Zone'']] will trigger so long as she hit at least one Vital and they die before the Vitals wear off. ** [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|Resurrection]] effects will not prevent the activation of the [[File:Fiora Grand Challenge 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|An icon for Fiora's ability Grand Challenge 2]] [[Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|''Victory Zone'']]. * The [[File:Fiora Grand Challenge 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|An icon for Fiora's ability Grand Challenge 2]] [[Fiora#Grand Challenge 2|Victory Zone]] will not heal [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] units. * '''Fiora''' will automatically attack the target upon casting if the target was selected while they were not in range of the ability. * Attempting to cast ''Grand Challenge'' on a target already affected by it will incur a 1-second cooldown and a text saying that the ability cannot be stacked will pop out of the target.
notes.text:
Grand Challenge is dispelled instantly if targeting a decoy.
* Grand Challenge cannot be cast on Sion's Glory in Death.
The damage of this ability scales with Duelist's Dance.
Even if Fiora dies, the Victory Zone will trigger so long as she hit at least one Vital and they die before the Vitals wear off.
* Resurrection effects will not prevent the activation of the Victory Zone.
The Victory Zone will not heal untargetable units.
Fiora will automatically attack the target upon casting if the target was selected while they were not in range of the ability.
Attempting to cast Grand Challenge on a target already affected by it will incur a 1-second cooldown and a text saying that the ability cannot be stacked will pop out of the target.
